objective: Write the literal string "OK" to the given path and return the write result code (the file_write capability returns 1 on success in this contract).
solution:
(module WriteMarker
  (extern defun file_write ((path : Str) (body : Str)) : Num @capability "file.write")

  (defun write_marker ((path : Str)) : Num
    (return (file_write path "OK")))

  (test t1 (mocks (file.write "/tmp/a.txt" 1)) (assert-eq (write_marker "/tmp/a.txt") 1))
  (test t2 (mocks (file.write "/var/log/x" 1)) (assert-eq (write_marker "/var/log/x") 1))
  (test t3 (mocks (file.write "/data/marker" 1)) (assert-eq (write_marker "/data/marker") 1)))

objective: Write the message `"count=" + decimal-string of n` to path, return the write result code.
solution:
(module WriteCountLabel
  (extern defun file_write ((path : Str) (body : Str)) : Num @capability "file.write")
  (defun write_count_label ((path : Str) (n : Num)) : Num
    (return (file_write path (str.concat "count=" (str.from_num n)))))
  (test t1 (mocks (file.write "/tmp/c.txt" 1)) (assert-eq (write_count_label "/tmp/c.txt" 0) 1))
  (test t2 (mocks (file.write "/tmp/c.txt" 1)) (assert-eq (write_count_label "/tmp/c.txt" 42) 1))
  (test t3 (mocks (file.write "/d/path" 1)) (assert-eq (write_count_label "/d/path" 1000) 1)))

solution:

objective: Write `key + "=" + decimal-string of value` to path (three concatenations); return the write result code.
solution:
(module WriteKeyValue
  (extern defun file_write ((path : Str) (body : Str)) : Num @capability "file.write")
  (defun write_key_value ((path : Str) (key : Str) (value : Num)) : Num
    (def body : Str (str.concat (str.concat key "=") (str.from_num value)))
    (return (file_write path body)))
  (test t1 (mocks (file.write "/cfg/a" 1)) (assert-eq (write_key_value "/cfg/a" "port" 8080) 1))
  (test t2 (mocks (file.write "/cfg/a" 1)) (assert-eq (write_key_value "/cfg/a" "timeout" 0) 1))
  (test t3 (mocks (file.write "/cfg/b" 1)) (assert-eq (write_key_value "/cfg/b" "size" 16) 1)))

objective: Read the source path, write the same content to the destination path, and return the length of the content as a number.
solution:
(module DuplicateFile
  (extern defun file_read  ((path : Str)) : Str @capability "file.read")
  (extern defun file_write ((path : Str) (body : Str)) : Num @capability "file.write")
  (defun duplicate_file ((src : Str) (dst : Str)) : Num
    (def body : Str (file_read src))
    (file_write dst body)
    (return (str.length body)))
  (test t1 (mocks (file.read "/s1" "hi") (file.write "/d1" 1)) (assert-eq (duplicate_file "/s1" "/d1") 2))
  (test t2 (mocks (file.read "/s2" "") (file.write "/d2" 1)) (assert-eq (duplicate_file "/s2" "/d2") 0))
  (test t3 (mocks (file.read "/s3" "hello world") (file.write "/d3" 1)) (assert-eq (duplicate_file "/s3" "/d3") 11)))

objective: Read the source path, then write a single line containing the decimal-string of the source length to the destination path; return the write result code.
solution:
(module EchoLengthToDst
  (extern defun file_read  ((path : Str)) : Str @capability "file.read")
  (extern defun file_write ((path : Str) (body : Str)) : Num @capability "file.write")
  (defun echo_length_to_dst ((src : Str) (dst : Str)) : Num
    (def body : Str (file_read src))
    (file_write dst (str.from_num (str.length body))))
  (test t1 (mocks (file.read "/s" "abc") (file.write "/d" 1)) (assert-eq (echo_length_to_dst "/s" "/d") 1))
  (test t2 (mocks (file.read "/s" "") (file.write "/d" 1)) (assert-eq (echo_length_to_dst "/s" "/d") 1))
  (test t3 (mocks (file.read "/s2" "longer string here") (file.write "/d2" 1)) (assert-eq (echo_length_to_dst "/s2" "/d2") 1)))

objective: Read source, then write `prefix + contents` (two-arg str.concat) to dst; return the write result code.
solution:
(module PrefixAndWrite
  (extern defun file_read  ((path : Str)) : Str @capability "file.read")
  (extern defun file_write ((path : Str) (body : Str)) : Num @capability "file.write")
  (defun prefix_and_write ((src : Str) (dst : Str) (prefix : Str)) : Num
    (def body : Str (file_read src))
    (def full : Str (str.concat prefix body))
    (return (file_write dst full)))
  (test t1 (mocks (file.read "/s" "body") (file.write "/d" 1)) (assert-eq (prefix_and_write "/s" "/d" ">> ") 1))
  (test t2 (mocks (file.read "/s" "") (file.write "/d" 1)) (assert-eq (prefix_and_write "/s" "/d" "P:") 1))
  (test t3 (mocks (file.read "/s" "x") (file.write "/d" 1)) (assert-eq (prefix_and_write "/s" "/d" "") 1)))

objective: Read source, upper-case its contents via str.upper, write the result to dst; return the write result code.
solution:
(module UppercaseToDst
  (extern defun file_read  ((path : Str)) : Str @capability "file.read")
  (extern defun file_write ((path : Str) (body : Str)) : Num @capability "file.write")
  (defun uppercase_to_dst ((src : Str) (dst : Str)) : Num
    (def body : Str (file_read src))
    (def upper : Str (str.upper body))
    (return (file_write dst upper)))
  (test t1 (mocks (file.read "/s" "hello") (file.write "/d" 1)) (assert-eq (uppercase_to_dst "/s" "/d") 1))
  (test t2 (mocks (file.read "/s" "AbC") (file.write "/d" 1)) (assert-eq (uppercase_to_dst "/s" "/d") 1))
  (test t3 (mocks (file.read "/s" "") (file.write "/d" 1)) (assert-eq (uppercase_to_dst "/s" "/d") 1)))

objective: Read two environment variables by name, parse each as a number with str.to_num, return their sum.
solution:
(module EnvPairSum
  (extern defun env_read ((key : Str)) : Str @capability "env.get")
  (defun env_pair_sum ((k1 : Str) (k2 : Str)) : Num
    (def va : Num (str.to_num (env_read k1)))
    (def vb : Num (str.to_num (env_read k2)))
    (+ va vb))
  (test t1 (mocks (env.get "A" "3") (env.get "B" "4")) (assert-eq (env_pair_sum "A" "B") 7))
  (test t2 (mocks (env.get "X" "0") (env.get "Y" "10")) (assert-eq (env_pair_sum "X" "Y") 10))
  (test t3 (mocks (env.get "P" "100") (env.get "Q" "50")) (assert-eq (env_pair_sum "P" "Q") 150)))

objective: Read the primary env var. If it's the empty string, read and return the fallback env var instead; otherwise return the primary value.
solution:
(module EnvOrOther
  (extern defun env_read ((key : Str)) : Str @capability "env.get")
  (defun env_or_other ((primary : Str) (fallback : Str)) : Str
    (def v : Str (env_read primary))
    (if (str.eq v "") (return (env_read fallback)) (return v)))
  (test t1 (mocks (env.get "PRIM" "main") (env.get "FALL" "alt")) (assert-eq (env_or_other "PRIM" "FALL") "main"))
  (test t2 (mocks (env.get "PRIM" "") (env.get "FALL" "alt")) (assert-eq (env_or_other "PRIM" "FALL") "alt"))
  (test t3 (mocks (env.get "PRIM" "") (env.get "FALL" "")) (assert-eq (env_or_other "PRIM" "FALL") "")))

objective: Fetch the URL, return the integer half-length of the body (use math.floor on length/2).
solution:
(module HttpHalfLength
  (extern defun http_fetch ((url : Str)) : Str @capability "http.fetch")
  (defun http_half_length ((url : Str)) : Num
    (def body : Str (http_fetch url))
    (return (math.floor (/ (str.length body) 2))))
  (test t1 (mocks (http.fetch "https://x/y" "hello")) (assert-eq (http_half_length "https://x/y") 2))
  (test t2 (mocks (http.fetch "https://x/y" "")) (assert-eq (http_half_length "https://x/y") 0))
  (test t3 (mocks (http.fetch "https://x/y" "abcdef")) (assert-eq (http_half_length "https://x/y") 3)))

objective: Run a scalar SQL count query, parse the result via str.to_num, return the count plus one.
solution:
(module DbCountPlusOne
  (extern defun sql_scalar ((conn : Str) (sql : Str)) : Str @capability "db.query")
  (defun db_count_plus_one ((conn : Str)) : Num
    (def raw : Str (sql_scalar conn "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users"))
    (def n : Num (str.to_num raw))
    (return (+ n 1)))
  (test t1 (mocks (db.query "c1" "0")) (assert-eq (db_count_plus_one "c1") 1))
  (test t2 (mocks (db.query "c1" "5")) (assert-eq (db_count_plus_one "c1") 6))
  (test t3 (mocks (db.query "c1" "100")) (assert-eq (db_count_plus_one "c1") 101)))
